basic_info.description: Welcome to Marina District living! This beautiful L‑shaped one‑bedroom condo surrounds a large walk-out private deck perfect for both entertaining and relaxing in style.  The bright and open layout features floor‑to‑ceiling windows and new engineered hardwood floors throughout and a walk-in closet at the entry. The kitchen offers gorgeous wood cabinetry with a new refrigerator, range hood, and lighting. The bedroom is a serene retreat with a roomy walk-in closet that overlooks the deck and the bathroom includes a modern vanity, fixtures, and lighting.  A 1-car deeded parking spot is also included.  Public transit is just steps away.  The vibrant Chestnut, Union, and Fillmore Streets with all their boutiques, cafes and acclaimed restaurants are a just short walk. Enjoy the proximity to Marina Green, Crissy Field, Fort Mason, the Presidio, Palace of Fine Arts, Marina Yacht Club and more.  Come and check out this wonderful condominium and the lifestyle filled with bayside strolls, park picnics, sailing, and weekend farmers markets that could be yours.
